title: Day counter (in Russian)
description: This datapack add text on top of your hotbar that will count the day realtime. Russian language version.
body:
Privet! My name is Vitaly Wilde. I have created a counter for the number of days played in Minecraft in Russian language.
# Description
![Main image with Russian day counter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e53f5a08db1e60906d97822a8700fab15ec022bf.png)

This datapack adds a bar to the top of the quick access panel that displays the number of days elapsed in real time. It consists of the word «Day» (in Russian «День») and the number of days that have passed.
# Commands
The datapack works perfectly with the commands used to change the in-game time of day. You can specify the exact number of ticks or use predefined keywords to switch quickly.
As the date range only reflects whole numbers of days, you can change the number of days using the command below (replace «*» with the number of days):

```
/time set *d
```
# Installation Guide
<details>
<summary>Installing in the new world</summary>

1. Download the .zip file, and do not extract it;
2. When creating a world, go to section «More» and click on button «Data Packs»;
3. Click on button «Open Pack Folder» and move the .zip file into the folder that has opened;
4. Select this data pack from the available options and press the button «Done».

</details>
<details>
<summary>Installing in the world created earlier</summary>

1. Download the .zip file, and do not extract it;
2. Find the folder containing the game world you want and open the «datapacks» folder within it;
3. Drop the .zip file inside of that folder.

</details>
